trans-unit.source: I've noticed you always hide your emotions.
trans-unit.target: I've noticed you always hide your emotions.

trans-unit.source: Such feelings are a hindrance to ninja.
trans-unit.target: Such feelings are a hindrance to ninja.

trans-unit.source: You can just SEE on her face how relaxed THAT girl is!
trans-unit.target: You can just SEE on her face how relaxed THAT girl is!

trans-unit.source: Sure, she's a bumbling idiot, but isn't it obvious she's enjoying herself?
trans-unit.target: Sure, she's a bumbling idiot, but isn't it obvious she's enjoying herself?

trans-unit.source: ...So you don't even care about being happy anymore? That's rough.
trans-unit.target: ...So you don't even care about being happy anymore? That's rough.

trans-unit.source: This is my clan's way of life.
trans-unit.target: This is my clan's way of life.
